decision: Use FastAPI BackgroundTasks instead of Celery for async LP generation
rationale: No extra infrastructure; sufficient for current load. Retry logic implemented in-process.
alternatives: Celery — full-featured but heavy, needs broker
revisit_when: When webhook retry durability becomes a pain point (server restart loses in-flight retries)

decision: SQLite + aiosqlite for tests, Supabase for dev/prod
rationale: Tests run without any external service. SQLAlchemy async is DB-agnostic; swap is a config change.
alternatives: Test against real Supabase dev — slow, network-dependent, can pollute data
revisit_when: If a Postgres-specific feature is needed that SQLite cannot emulate

decision: Disabled superpowers plugin; harness built manually from harness.md
rationale: User wants skills invoked manually only, not auto-triggered at session start.
alternatives: Keep plugin enabled, ignore using-superpowers skill
revisit_when: If superpowers plugin adds opt-in mode for session-start skill
